title: A Multifrequency ALMA Characterization of Substructures in the GM Aur Protoplanetary Disk
question: What are the dust substructures, spectral index variations, optical depths and gas cavity of the GM Aur disk at high resolution in Bands 4 and 6?

data.sensitivity: rms 0.012 mJy/beam (2.1 mm), 0.01 mJy/beam (1.1 mm), 1.2 mJy/beam per 0.25 km/s channel (HCO+)

what.value: Midplane dust temperature model from SED and resolved mm modeling, used for optical depths

evidence.quote: midplane dust temperatures derived in Mac´ıas et al. (2018) through radiative transfer modeling of GM Aur’s SED and resolved millimeter continuum observations.
a stellar mass of 1.32 M ⊙ (Andrews et al. 2018a)
we adopt the default “DSHARP dust opacities” described in Birnstiel et al. (2018)

what.value: Gas temperature structure from McClure et al. 2016 for comparison with HCO+ brightness temperature

evidence.loc: 5.2. Constraints on the HCO + distribution and temperature
evidence.quote: Using a linear interpolation of the two-dimensional temperature structures from McClure et al. (2016) and Mac´ıas et al. (2018)

recipe.goal: Calibrate, align and self-calibrate, then image continuum
recipe.method: ALMA pipeline, fixvis/fixplanets alignment, self-cal, tclean multiscale imaging in each band
Deproject images, azimuthally average, smooth 1.1 mm to 2.1 mm resolution, compute alpha = log(I1/I0)/log(nu1/nu0)
key_parameters: P.A. = 57.17 deg, i = 53.21 deg, 1 au bins
assumptions: Distance 159 pc; ~10% flux calibration uncertainty per band

recipe.goal: Fit axisymmetric surface brightness models in uv plane
recipe.method: Delta function + Gaussian rings parametrization, vis_sample synthetic visibilities, MCMC, 21 free parameters
key_parameters: 96 walkers, 20,000 steps, 10,000 burn-in; weights scaled down by 2.667

recipe.goal: Optical depth and grain size constraints
recipe.method: tau_nominal = -ln(1 - I/B(T)); beta from tau ratio; emergent intensity with scattering via analytic slab approximation
assumptions: Midplane temperature from Macías et al. 2018; DSHARP opacities; gas-to-dust ratio 100 for Toomre Q

recipe.goal: Test B84 geometry with radiative transfer
recipe.method: RADMC-3D models: flat, thick, warped rings, imaged with CASA and plotted in polar deprojection
key_parameters: 512 radial cells, 1024 poloidal cells, 64 azimuthal cells, 10^8 photon packages; parameters in Table 4

recipe.method: Quadratic-fit velocity map with bettermoments, fit Keplerian flared-surface model with eddy
key_parameters: Fit radii 0.2-2 arcsec; 48 walkers, 3500 steps, 500 burn-in
assumptions: Keplerian rotation; PA, inclination, offsets fixed to continuum values

recipe.goal: HCO+ integrated flux and brightness temperature
recipe.method: Keplerian-mask integrated intensity; peak brightness temperature map without continuum subtraction; power-law fit
key_parameters: Integration range -1.25 to 12.75 km/s; fit over R = 30-350 au

evidence.quote: the disk-averaged spectral index between 1.1 and 2.1 mm is α = 2 . 7 ± 0 . 2

answer_key.quantity: Peak nominal optical depth B40 and B84 at 1.1 mm

evidence.loc: 5.2. Constraints on the HCO + distribution and temperature
5.2. Constraints on the HCO + distribution and temperature
6.2. Origin of the central compact emission
evidence.quote: 0 . 28 ± 0 . 02 mJy at 1.1 mm and 0 . 09 ± 0 . 02 mJy at 2.1 mm

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels flagged for Band 6 continuum
Self-calibration solution intervals and number of iterations
Gaussian taper parameters for the HCO+ cube
CLEAN thresholds and image size/cell size
Exact visibility binning and weight handling code for the MCMC fits
Which data reduction scripts were used (not released)
score_reason: Data public and the modeling approach is well described with priors and MCMC settings, but several imaging and self-cal parameters and the thermal model inputs are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Public data and a described recipe with numeric results (fluxes, spectral index, table of fit parameters), though some settings are unstated.
